केन ind. By what? whence, how, why; वत्सोपमन्यो केन वृत्तिं
 कल्पयसि Mb. 1. 3. 36. {@केनेशितोपनिषद्, केनोपनिषद्@} N. of one
 of the old principal Upaniṣads.
केनती The amorous sports of love.

—1 The head.
—2 The skull.
—3 A cheek.
—4 A joint.
—5 The temples.
—6 A kind of hell.

केनिप a. Ved. Wise, learned (मेधाविन्); यथा केनिपानामिनो
 वृधे Rv. 10. 44. 4.
केनिपातः A rudder, helm, a large oar used as a rudder.

केन्दुः, -न्दुकः
 N. of a tree (Mangosteen), a variety of ebony.

केन्दुः, -न्दुकः
 N. of a tree (Mangosteen), a variety of ebony.

—1 The centre of a circle.
—2 The argument of a circle.
—3 The argument of an equation.
—4 Distance of a planet from the first point of its orbit in the 4th,
 7th or 10th degree.
—5 The first, fourth, seventh and tenth lunar mansion.
